title: Invalidate sessions immediately on account deactivation
intent: When an administrator deactivates a user account, make sure that user's existing session tokens are invalidated immediately, not just blocked from future logins.
acceptance_criteria: A deactivated user's existing session token is rejected immediately after deactivation
Existing active-user login and token validation is unaffected
expected_risks: Revoking sessions on deactivation is a cross-service change (UserService calling into AuthService)
expected_tests: deactivated user's existing token is rejected
expected_failure_modes: Deactivated user retains a still-valid session token (current bug)
